description:
Delivers matching object events to a queue in the same stack.
Rules on one Storage must not overlap: no object key may match two of them.
Delivery is at least once, so consumers must tolerate duplicates.

items.description: Object events that can be delivered to a queue.

events.description: Events to deliver. Defaults to object creation; v1 supports only `created`.

prefix.description: Literal object key prefix, non-empty and at most 512 UTF-8 bytes when set.

queue.description: Target Queue. It must have the same lifecycle as the Storage.

type.description: Resource type identifier that determines the specific kind of resource. This field is used for polymorphic deserialization and resource-specific behavior.

suffix.description: Literal object key suffix, non-empty and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes when set.
